latestVersion.changelog:
v0.1.1 Changelog

- Clarified that all research and content generation use only publicly available Internet sources.
- Updated SKILL.md to require each generated skill begin with a disclaimer stating “not the person themself”, and to include a limitations/statement after each response.
- Refined research phase language to focus solely on positive, verifiable professional achievements; removed references to filtering “negative noise/rumors”.
- Modified directory instructions to use the current workspace for skill generation.
- Updated workflow and documentation for greater transparency and stricter compliance.
